how_to_apply: Open the Google Form link given in the notice. The link is valid from the date of publication of the advertisement to 16 November 2026, 12:00 pm. No physical application is accepted.
Submit the form. An auto-generated mail with a prefilled application form follows; follow the instructions in it.
Collect the admit card on 17 November 2026 between 9:30 AM and 12:00 PM at the Conference Hall, Admin Block, Dr. B S A Hospital, Sector VI, Rohini, New Delhi-110085.
Bring the printout of the filled form, the photocopy and original of photo ID, and 2 passport size photographs.
Report for the written test on 20 November 2026 by 1:00 pm with the original admit card and one original photo ID.

The accepted photo IDs are Aadhar card, Election ID card, passport or PAN Card. No other document is valid for identification. For queries or discrepancies, write to [email protected]. The application form and other information are also on www.delhi.gov.in under the link Departments/Dr. B.S A. Hospital.

Selection is purely on merit, based on a written test (MCQ based). The test lasts 1 hour, from 2:00 pm to 3:00 pm. No entry is allowed after 1:30 pm. The venue is informed on the day the admit cards are issued. The notice prints no number of questions, marks or negative marking.

The admit card is provisional. Final selection of shortlisted candidates after the written exam is subject to verification of original documents. Candidates who prove ineligible on any criterion have their candidature cancelled. The result is displayed on the hospital website and notice board outside the MD office, with no individual communication.

The notice states that these dates are to be treated as the last word if there is any ambiguity. If a holiday is declared on a stipulated date, the schedule shifts to the next working day or as decided by the Medical Director.
important_instructions: Candidature is rejected if any discrepancy is found at any stage in documents or information. False information or suppression of a material fact leads to cancellation or termination. Administrative or legal action may follow, and the Dental Council of India or State council will be informed. The decision of the Selection Board / Medical Director is final and binding, and no representation is entertained. Candidates should check the hospital notice board and official website for lists of shortlisted and selected candidates. No letter or personal information is given. Joining is subject to original documents verification.

content_sections.heading: About BSAH
content_sections.text: Dr. Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital is run by the Government of NCT of Delhi and is located at Sector 6, Rohini, Delhi 110085. The recruitment is handled by its Resident Cell. The hospital is opposite Dr Baba Saheb Ambedkar Hospital Metro station on the Red line.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 06 posts in the Dental department. The number of posts is provisional and may change according to vacancies lying vacant or likely to be vacant, without notice. Seats will be reserved for differently able candidates as per prevailing Govt rules; the notice prints no number for them. A category-wise wait list may also be prepared for vacancies likely to arise in future. It stays valid till the next interview or six months from declaration of result, whichever is earlier.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The candidate must have a valid State Dental Council registration certificate for the BDS qualification at the time of the exam. A candidate without valid registration need not apply. Registration with the state dental council or the Dental Council of India is required. Those who have already done Junior Residency for one year in any Govt./Govt. aided institution are not eligible. Total Junior Residency is one year irrespective of institute. A candidate who has done less than one year in a Govt./Govt. aided institute is eligible for the rest of the tenure, but the total will never exceed one year. OBC seats are for candidates belonging to Delhi only, with a Delhi OBC certificate with valid NCL (non-creamy layer) issued in the current financial year. An applicant under OBC who is not in the Delhi OBC list is considered under UR only. EWS seats are for candidates belonging to Delhi only, with a Delhi EWS certificate issued in the current financial year. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.qualification: BDS degree from recognized Indian university / Institute
rows.experience: Must have completed one year internship on or after 16.11.25

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay Scale: in accordance with 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi. Appointment is initially for 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier. Extension depends on a satisfactory Work & Conduct report from the concerned HOD and a written request from the doctor concerned. Either party can end the contract with seven days' notice. No notice period is given when service is terminated on disciplinary ground. Selected candidates must join within one week (stipulated time). No TA/DA is paid for the written test or selection process.

The venue is informed on the day the admit cards are issued. The notice prints no number of questions, marks or negative marking. The admit card is provisional. Final selection of shortlisted candidates after the written exam is subject to verification of original documents. Candidates who prove ineligible on any criterion have their candidature cancelled. content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Printout of the filled application form (prefilled, from the auto-generated mail). Photocopy and original of the photo ID mentioned in the form (Aadhar card / Election ID card / passport / PAN card). 2 passport size photographs. Original admit card and one original photo ID on the exam day. Documents for reservation (SC/ST/OBC/EWS/PH), verified on the day of admit card collection, plus a self-attested copy. Valid State Dental Council registration certificate. Original documents for verification before joining.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident (Dental) vacancies are there at BSAH?
faq.answer: There are 06 posts: 3 UR, 1 SC, 1 OBC and 1 EWS. The number is provisional and may change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online form closes on 16 November 2026 at 12:00 pm. No physical application is accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: A BDS degree from a recognized Indian university or institute, with one year of internship completed on or after 16.11.25. A valid State Dental Council registration is also needed.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The limit is 30 years for the Gen. category as on the date of closure of the advertisement. ST/SC get 5 years' relaxation and OBC get 3 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Pay is in accordance with 7th CPC guidelines as adopted by GNCT of Delhi. The notice prints no amount.

faq.question: Q6. How is selection done?
faq.answer: Selection is on merit based on a 1-hour MCQ written test. Final selection depends on verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q7. When and where is the written test?
faq.answer: The test is on 20 November 2026; candidates must report by 1:00 pm and the exam runs 2:00 pm to 3:00 pm. The venue is informed when admit cards are issued.

faq.question: Q8. When and where can I collect the admit card?
faq.answer: Admit cards are issued on 17 November 2026 from 9:30 AM to 12:00 PM at the Conference Hall, Admin Block, Dr. B S A Hospital, Rohini.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. Appointment is initially for 89 days, extendable up to a maximum of one year or till the regular incumbent joins, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates who already did Junior Residency apply?
faq.answer: Not if they completed one year in a Govt./Govt. aided institution. Those with less than one year can apply for the remaining period, with the total never exceeding one year.
